sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Reshala's bunkhouse key (Reshala) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: It's unclear which specific bunkhouse this key belongs to. But it should be somewhere on the Customs territory.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter Accidental Witness

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- On Reshala
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to Reshala's bunkhouse on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Jacket
- Possible TOZ-106 20ga bolt-action shotgun
- Possible PPSh-41 7.62x25 submachine gun
- Possible AS VAL 9x39 special assault rifle
- Possible VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle
- Possible Soyuz-TM STM-9 Gen.2 9x19 carbine
- Possible UVSR Taiga-1 survival machete or SP-8 Survival Machete
- Possible modified Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun
- Loose loot (Valuables, Stimulants)
